hints.title: Boundary Comparison
hints.text: The maximum distance between two unequal elements always involves either the first element or the last element.

hints.title: Two Anchor Scan
hints.text: Compare every element at index i against words[0] (yielding distance i) and words[n-1] (yielding distance n - 1 - i).

hints.title: Global Maximum
hints.text: Track the maximum of all valid distances where words differ from the anchor.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: L: maximum length of a word string
complexity.notes: Single pass comparing against first and last elements.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing all pairs of words results in O(N^2 * L) runtime.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that extreme optimal pairs must anchor at array boundaries.
